english.title: Cause administer poison / noxious thing with intent to injure / aggrieve / annoy
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully and maliciously

(A)_[administered to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[caused to be administered to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(C)_[caused to be taken by **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_

a poison or other destructive or noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SUBSTANCE..), with intent to injure, aggrieve or annoy the said **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.

english.notes:
(i) See also Standard Offence Wording document H5811 and H2003.
(ii) See section 72 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by a UK national or a person habitually resident in England and Wales.
